name: ONE WAY
spec: black horizontal rectangle with a white arrow pointing right and white legend ONE WAY inside the arrow
meaning: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.

snippets.back: A one-way instruction requires travel only in the indicated direction.
The centerline separates traffic moving in opposite directions, and the manual says it is painted yellow on two-lane highways and white on multi-lane highways and one-way streets.
When you turn left from a one-way road onto a two-way road, turn into the lane just to the right of the center line.
An approaching one-way bridge may require a stop before crossing.
Roundabouts are spreading in the U.S. because one-way counterclockwise flow creates fewer conflict points and moves traffic more safely and efficiently than standard intersections.
A left turn from a one-way road onto a two-way road can never be made against a red light.
For a left turn from a two-way street onto a one-way street, signal at least one hundred feet ahead, yield to road users, check for pedestrians and turn into the first lane.
A white-on-red regulatory sign warns that you are heading onto a one-way highway or ramp from the wrong direction.
